subject: general
question: On which of the following rivers was Independent India's first river dam constructed?
solution:
The correct answer is **Damodar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC)** was the first major multipurpose river valley project undertaken by the Government of India after independence.
 
• The project was initiated in **1948** and aimed at flood control, irrigation, and power generation.
 
• The Damodar River, often referred to as the "Sorrow of Bengal" due to its frequent floods, was chosen for this significant project.
 
• The first dam constructed under this project was the **Tilaiya Dam**, which became operational in 1953.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1: Damodar
 First major multipurpose river valley project in Independent India, initiated in 1948.
 
 

 Option 2: Krishna
 Known for dams like Nagarjuna Sagar and Srisailam, but these were constructed later.
 
 

 Option 3: Ganga
 Has many significant dams like the Farakka Barrage, but not the first in Independent India.
 
 

 Option 4: Yamuna
 Famous for the Tajewala Barrage and Hathnikund Barrage, but these were also constructed later.
